summary: Learn Dockerfiles, container networking, Compose, and image workflows in 5 days. Build practical container skills with hands-on labs.
lede: Docker and containerisation training helps technical professionals build, run, and manage containers for consistent software delivery. Participants practise writing Dockerfiles, improving image layers, controlling container runtimes, configuring networks and persistent volumes, and assembling multi-container workflows with Docker Compose. They also cover registry tagging, introductory security scanning, and operational handover, using logs, resource checks, and troubleshooting to support deployment and ongoing operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technical professionals who already work around software delivery, infrastructure, or application support and need practical Docker capability.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of Linux command-line basics, files and permissions, and common application deployment concepts. Familiarity with virtual machines, TCP/IP fundamentals, and software development or system administration workflows will help you move faster. No programming language is required for completion, but you should be comfortable following technical instructions, editing text files, and using a terminal. Participants are expected to bring a laptop with Docker Desktop or Docker Engine access, and the trainer will use guided labs and sample application files during the course.
